tier_should.rationale: Strong theoretical sufficient-statistics framework integrating pass-through and heterogeneity; novel emphasis on distortion-variance; implemented with two RCTs. Credible design, clear welfare relevance, and portability across markets. Fits general-interest economics.

tier_will.rationale: High-profile authors, timely topic, rigorous theory plus experiments. Likely A-journal or top field placement. Potential concerns: external validity and measurement of heterogeneity and targeting. Still strong odds at top-five.
